issues.title: Fix hardcoded user-facing strings across policy and resource action hooks
docs: create CI.md to document e2e pipeline design and decisions
API Product deletion type to confirm missing when deleting from details

prSummary.problem: APIProduct detail page Actions dropdown used the SDK's built-in useDeleteModal (simple checkbox confirmation), while the list page kebab already used the custom type-to-confirm APIProductDeleteModal — inconsistent delete UX across views.
prSummary.solution: Replaced useDeleteModal with the SDK's useModal hook to launch APIProductDeleteModal from the Actions dropdown, matching PatternFly's 'Confirm a destructive action' guidelines. Detail page now navigates back to the APIProducts list after successful deletion.
keyChanges: Added optional onDeleteSuccess callback to APIProductDeleteModal so detail page can navigate away on success
Moved setIsDeleting cleanup out of finally into catch only — avoids setState-on-unmount warnings
Switched useAPIProductActions from useDeleteModal to useModal with APIProductDeleteModalWrapper
Updated e2e delete flow to type the resource name into #confirm-delete instead of checking a checkbox

prSummary.problem: Header contents inside the DNS, TLS, and OIDC policy creation tabs were extremely left-aligned, mismatching the rest of the page layout.
prSummary.solution: Identified a PatternFly `pf-m-no-padding` modifier class applied to the body wrapper of each policy header. Commenting it out restored correct alignment across all three policy pages.
keyChanges: Commented out `pf-m-no-padding` class on DNS, TLS, and OIDC header wrappers
No logic changes — pure layout fix
Verified visually: headers now align with other page content

issues.title: Add GatewayClass filtering for gateway tables

prSummary.problem: Gateway tables showed all gateways including irrelevant types (e.g. waypoint gateways with gatewayClassName 'istio-waypoint'). Only Name, Namespace, and Type filters existed — no GatewayClass filter.
prSummary.solution: Extended ResourceList with a reusable additionalFilters prop (PatternFly dropdown select), then wired a GatewayClass filter on the Overview 'Gateways - Traffic Analysis' card, populated dynamically from cluster GatewayClass resources.
keyChanges: Added AdditionalFilter type and optional additionalFilters prop to ResourceList (default [])
When an additional filter is active, toolbar text input switches to a Select dropdown with an All option
Extended Gateway interface with spec.gatewayClassName; watch GatewayClass resources for dropdown options
Passed GatewayClass filter into Overview gateway ResourceList comparing spec.gatewayClassName

issues.title: API Product deletion type to confirm UI enhancement

prSummary.problem: API Product and API Key deletion modals had inconsistent UI/UX — different sizes, layouts, and confirmation patterns between the two flows.
prSummary.solution: Used the API Key modal as a consistent base and redesigned both modals to follow PatternFly's 'Confirm a destructive action' guidelines, unifying the experience across both resource types.
keyChanges: Modal size reduced from medium → small for a more focused feel
Added warning icon and simplified messaging to a single line
Improved placeholder text: 'Enter API Product name' for better guidance
Simplified confirm button label from 'Delete API Product' → 'Delete'
Added useEffect hook to reliably reset the confirmation field on all close methods (Cancel, ESC, click-outside)
Reorganised imports to match project conventions; added kuadrant.css import

issues.title: Cancel button navigates to resource list instead of previous page

prSummary.problem: Cancel buttons on create/edit forms (policies, Gateways, HTTPRoutes — Form and YAML view) navigate to the resource list page instead of the previous page, breaking natural navigation flow.
prSummary.solution: Closed as not technically feasible. The OpenShift Console SDK's ResourceYAMLEditor does not expose an onCancel prop or any way to customise the cancel button. A custom YAML editor wrapper would be fragile and unnecessary given the planned form view work.
keyChanges: Custom YAML editor approach investigated and ruled out
Textarea alternative considered and discarded
Confirmed via SDK type definitions: cancel customisation is not supported
Same broken behaviour found on HTTPRoutes and Gateway YAML creation
Resolution deferred to upcoming form view redesign
